measurement_history.fact: The GKD daily record starts on this date.
Gauge zero 299.58 m NHN (DHHN2016); operated by the federal waterway office for the Danube (WSA Donau MDK). Past gauge zeros are not listed.
Hofkirchen lies on the roughly 70 km free-flowing Danube stretch between Straubing and Vilshofen.
Our comparison with Pfelling shows the gap between the two gauges widening by about 20 cm over 1964 to 1966 at similar flows; which gauge changed, and why, was not found.
Early reading method, recorder start date and riverbed change: not found.

public_notes: The level is measured against a fixed mark below the riverbed, not the depth of the water. Values from January 2026 on are raw readings that the Bavarian agency has not checked yet.
